name: Lean Canvas
description: Completes a Lean Canvas for a specific business idea covering problem, solution, unique value proposition, unfair advantage, customer segments, key metrics, channels, cost structure, and revenue streams. Use when the user asks about Lean Canvas, one-page business model, lean startup canvas, or business model canvas for startups. Do NOT use for a traditional business plan (use business-plan), idea validation experiments (use idea-validation), or MVP scoping (use mvp-definition).
